EventChunk.description: One chunk of an event's text: at most 30,000 characters, cut at a heading, else at a line.

content_free.description:
Nothing a change record could come from (structural headings, links, boilerplate): central makes no model call
for such a chunk.

id.description: `{event id}#{index}`, index from 0: stable while the source is (central keys its records `{this}.{n}`).

sha256.description: Hex sha256 of `text` (UTF-8): the cache key for anything derived from the chunk.

oneOf.description: A security advisory (GitHub Advisory Database); the quote is its id and summary.

Freshness.description: When a release's event reached each stage, so the gap from release to catalog is measured (ISO timestamps).

backfilled.description:
The source was already known when central began recording the technology's events (its history when it was
added, or a technology covered before events existed): `first_seen` is that start, not when the release appeared.

first_published.description: When central first wrote this event into the technology's index.

first_seen.description: When central first read this source.

registry_published.description: When the registry says the version was published; absent when no registry gives a time for it.

description:
One line of an events shard (`TechIndex::events`): one source document of one release (its release notes, an upgrade
guide, or a change to its documentation), normalised and split into chunks exactly as central's extraction reads
it. Deterministic: no model has seen it.

chunks.description: The text in order; joined with `\n` they are the whole text central extracts from.

date.description: ISO date, `YYYY-MM-DD`: the release's day (the registry's where it has one), as records carry it.

id.description:
`{technology}@{version}` plus the source's tag when it is not the release body alone (`+linked.<8 hex>`,
`+guide.<8 hex>`, `+docs.<8 hex>`): the prefix of the keys central gives the records it extracts from it.

line.description: The release line, major (or 0.minor below 1.0): what the event's shard is named by.

name.description: The technology's name as the extraction prompt states it (`Technology: …`).

no_later_than.description:
Set for a source read from a moving page: the change shipped in a release from `version` up to this one
(`Release::no_later_than`).

prompt_date.description:
ISO date the extraction prompt states (`Release: <version> (<date>)`) when it is not `date`: the GitHub release's
day, kept so the prompt does not move when the registry's day arrives later.

snapshot.description: `sha256:` plus the hex digest of the snapshot the text was taken from (`Evidence::snapshot`).

title: EventLine
